title: The Hunting of the Snark: An Agony in Eight Fits
sourceTitle: The Hunting of the Snark: An Agony in Eight Fits
author: Lewis Carroll
description: "The Hunting of the Snark: An Agony in Eight Fits" by Lewis Carroll is a nonsense poem written between 1874 and 1876.
longDescription: A crew of ten peculiar characters embarks on an absurd quest to hunt the mysterious Snark, guided only by a blank map. Their journey becomes increasingly strange as they encounter fantastical creatures and face a terrifying possibility: the Snark might actually be a deadly Boojum.

authorInfo.bio: Lewis Carroll was the pen name of Charles Lutwidge Dodgson, an English mathematician, writer and photographer. Alice’s Adventures in Wonderland and Through the Looking-Glass turn logic and language into imaginative play. His nonsense verse includes The Hunting of the Snark and Jabberwocky.
